# Dextria Digital Agency

> Dextria is a creative digital agency specializing in custom web design, mobile application development, search engine optimization (SEO), and digital marketing solutions.

## Core Capabilities
- Web Design & UX/UI Architecture
- Full-Stack Web & Mobile App Development
- SEO & Search Visibility Strategy
- Social Media & Content Marketing
- Email Marketing Automation
- PPC & Performance Advertising
